items.creationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-quality landscape character turnaround sheet, 1536 x 1024 pixels, containing EXACTLY THREE full-body views of the SAME character: FRONT on the left, true 90-degree SIDE PROFILE facing image LEFT in the middle, and straight BACK on the right. All views strictly orthographic, neutral standing relaxed A-pose with arms 15 degrees away from torso, feet flat, same scale, skull-top / chin / shoulders / pelvis / knees / soles aligned horizontally. Whole hair, headgear, fingertips and shoes fully inside canvas with generous clearance and equal column spacing. Plain warm very light gray background, subtle shared floor baseline, soft consistent studio illumination. No weapons, props, floating effects, extra portraits, insets, panels, logos, labels, numbers, letters or watermark.
ART DIRECTION: Redesign this existing game's character with the expressive stylized 3D proportions and street-sport energy of Splatoon 3, while preserving her own human identity and signature outfit. Smooth clean game-ready 3D/cel-shaded concept rendering, big expressive eyes, rounded large head with subtly tapered chin, SMALL narrow shoulders, compact torso, slender limbs, oversized hands and especially chunky rounded thick-soled footwear. Approximately 3.8 HEADS TALL (anatomical skull crown to chin = 1 unit; chin to crotch = 1.1 units; crotch to soles = 1.7 units); head width approximately shoulder width. Headwear and upright hair accessories do NOT count as part of the head-length unit. Deliberately simplify tiny buckles, hair strands, seams into readable large design shapes. Modest compact torso, no exaggerated chest/hips. Do not preserve the tall realistic/anime anatomy of a reference screenshot. No squid ears, tentacle hair or Inkling eye-mask added. Keep original human ears and hair identity. Three views must describe a single consistent reconstructible design: matching hairstyle length, left/right accessory placement, garment seams, bag straps, footwear and colors. A single side bun must stay on the same anatomical side when seen from back. Natural hair drape, no wind.
CHARACTER: 紫苑 / RifleGirl. Identity reference 1 is the current portrait: ash taupe-gray long hair with a bun on her anatomical left, pink beret with small dark cross-shaped badge, purple-pink eyes, tiny cheek beauty mark, gentle confident closed-mouth smile. Preserve these recognizable clothing components; reinterpret the boots as extra chunky rounded sport-tactical boots. Hair ends around the hips of the redesigned body, low-detail sculpted locks. Keep all three poses neutral and symmetric. The body MUST visibly be close to 3.8 heads tall, not the adult proportions of the source model.
